name: Segmented Dataset Rendering with Anatomical Feature Enhancement
aliases: Sliced Volume Rendering with Segmentation Labels
definition: A new algorithm for rendering segmented datasets that 'paints' various colors acquired from segmentation to the rendered volume, delivering higher image quality with smoother subvolume boundaries compared to using different TFs for segmented object separation.
summary: Segmented Dataset Rendering with Anatomical Feature Enhancement paints colors from segmentation labels directly onto the volume, replacing discrete testing to eliminate jagged edges and enhance anatomical features.
